# Interior Design Appointment & Portfolio System - MERN Stack

This is a professional MERN stack web application for interior designers and clients to manage appointments, view portfolios, and share design projects.

- [x] Project Requirements Clarified - MERN Stack Interior Design Appointment System
- [x] Project Structure Scaffolded - Backend and Frontend directories created

## Quick Start

### Prerequisites
- Node.js (v18+)
- npm or yarn
- MongoDB (local or Atlas connection string)

### Installation & Running

#### Backend Setup
```bash
cd backend
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Update .env with your MongoDB URL and JWT secret
npm run dev
```

#### Frontend Setup
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
```

#### Access the Application
- Frontend: http://localhost:3000
- Backend API: http://localhost:5000
